events.title: San Diego Comic-Con Graphic Novel Book Club
events.description:
Oceanside Public Library hosts a Graphic Novel Book Club for adults in partnership with San Diego Comic-Con International.

This program meets the 2nd Thursday of each month and is currently meeting online from January - November and in person in December at the Civic Center Library.

Book Club members decide on the topics and books for each month.

Titles Coming Soon...
events.location: Oceanside Public Library (online January-November, Civic Center Library in December)
